symbols.name: BaseQuaternion<float>::fromMat
symbols.note: Shoemake's trace-based matrix-to-quaternion over the same layout: with a positive trace, w = 0.5 sqrt(trace + 1), x = (M[9] - M[6]) / 4w, y = (M[2] - M[8]) / 4w, z = (M[4] - M[1]) / 4w - the exact inverse of toMat 0x00461690, with no conjugation. Skeleton::setRelativeBoneTransform's weight < 1 branch uses it on the current local before slerping. lnxded twin 0x08226280.

symbols.name: BaseQuaternion<float>::toMat
symbols.note: thiscall(this = quaternion, out Mat4). The unconjugated rotation with s = 2 / (x^2 + y^2 + z^2 + w^2): row 0 = [1 - s(yy + zz), s(xy - zw), s(xz + yw)], row 1 = [s(xy + zw), 1 - s(xx + zz), s(yz - xw)], row 2 = [s(xz - yw), s(yz + xw), 1 - s(xx + yy)], written row-major to indices 0-2, 4-6, 8-10; indices 3, 7 and 11-14 zero, 15 one. Fields x, y, z, w at +0..+0xc; 2.0 at 0x008d5a38. Because of s the result is unchanged by any uniform scale or sign of the quaternion. Called with the quaternion unmodified by Skeleton::setRelativeBoneTransform 0x0066b5c0 (both branches) and by applyOnSkeleton's direct path (0x0066b9dd). lnxded twin 0x08226180 (ledger BAF-1).

symbols.name: BfMap__animate
symbols.note: Per-frame minimap layout tick, thiscall(float dt); only caller FUN_006ad0a0 (call at 0x006adab5). Name descriptive (stripped client, no server twin). Zoom +0x40 += (target - zoom) * (1 - exp(-9 dt)), target = byte +0x3c != 0 (write 0x00469004; -9.0 at 0x008d6294). +0x44 eases toward +0x48 at rate 6 (-6.0 at 0x008d628c) and alpha +0x4c toward +0x50 by the zoom's own factor, each snapping within 0.01 (0x008c409c). Rotation +0x64 (write 0x004691c8) is not eased: with byte +0x58 clear it moves to (1 - zoom) * wrap(+0x68) by the shorter of the two 2pi windings; with +0x58 set it only re-wraps itself; and it holds still for the frame when zoom < 0.8 (0x008d6290) and byte +0xa9 of the object playerManager (0x0097d76c) vtable +0x18 returns is clear. Finally writes the inherited TransformNode position (+0xc) = (400 + 220(1 - zoom) - 120 zoom, 30) and size (+0x14) = 175 + 337 zoom on both axes (constants 0x008d6270-0x008d6288): a top-right square, 175 closed and 512 open, in 800x600 units.

symbols.note: BfMap vtable slot +0x74 (overrides TransformNode's). Texture crop scale pow(2.3, (1 - [+0x40]) * [+0x44]) with 2.3 read as a double from 0x008d62a0, a 2x2 rotation from cos/sin of -[+0x64], and the mouse-pick hit test through TransformNode__getSize. +0x40 (zoom) and +0x64 (rotation) are written by BfMap__animate 0x00468fb0 (ledger MMAP-1, MMAP-2); the writers of +0x3c (the zoom toggle), +0x48 and +0x68 are unread.

symbols.name: dice::ref2::world::PhysicsEngine::updatePhysics
symbols.note: Thrust. Found via the PhysicsEngine vtable at 0x008fdf50. rho = 1 - clamp(pos.y/getAirDensityZeroAtHeight(), 0, 1); e = throttle - rho*(vel . fwd)/EngineTemplate.setNoPropellerEffectAtSpeed; K = 0.1*|throttle| + e*|e| (a SIGNED SQUARE, not the linear fade flight-model.md 6 assumes); force = fwd * K * getCurrentRatio(), applied at the ENGINE NODE'S OWN POSITION (not the CoM) via rootNode vtable+0x68. setTorque is absent from this expression. Medium gate: an engine runs only when its EngineTemplate flag bit 3 matches the medium (submerged vs air), which is what separates c_ETShip from c_ETPlane. Tail is prop visuals: spin rate = throttle*400 below |throttle|<0.08, else throttle*20. Linux twin: 0x0824cbb0.

symbols.name: dice::ref2::world::calculateLift
symbols.note: THE lift equation, whole. calculateLift(const Vec3& vel, const Vec3& unused, const Vec3& surfaceUp, float coeff) -> acceleration m/s^2. len=|vel|; if len==0 return 0; s=clamp(dot(vel/len, surfaceUp),-1,1); a=asin(s)*57.29578 (DEGREES); c = 0 if |a|>=45 else a*(45-a)/506.25 for a>=0, a*(45+a)/506.25 for a<0; return (0.75*c + 0.25*s) * len*len * coeff * 0.0025. SPEED EXPONENT IS 2 (len*len), settling flyable-vehicles/flight-model.md 9c item 1. Peak coefficient 1.0 at 22.5 deg, hard zero at +-45 deg = a built-in stall model. MSVC folded /506.25 into *0.0019753086419753087, which is why a byte search for 506.25 misses. Small-angle slope: 0.75*45/506.25 + 0.25*pi/180 = 0.07103 per degree = 4.0699 per radian. Matched instruction-for-instruction against dice::ref2::world::calculateLift at 0x0824eb20 in bf1942_lnxded.static (which carries a 4th leading Vec3 param that the body never reads).

symbols.name: dice::ref2::world::PhysicsWing::updatePhysics
symbols.note: Per-surface aero. Found via the PhysicsWing vtable at 0x008fead8. coeff = (WingTemplate.setWingLift + WingTemplate.setFlapLift) * getGravity() * -0.101833 (= -1/9.82), i.e. the two .con lift values are SUMMED into one coefficient and scaled by g/9.82 = 1.49995 at the shipped g=-14.7295. There is no separate flapLift*deflection term: hinge deflection reaches the maths only through the surface's world matrix. force = -clamp(calculateLift(...) * medium, -200, 200) * surfaceUp(row1 of the surface matrix), applied as an ACCELERATION at the surface's world position via rootNode vtable+0x68. medium = 10.0 when below the water/terrain height (World vtable+0x5c), else 1 - clamp(y/getAirDensityZeroAtHeight(), 0, 1). Regulator, gated on WingTemplate+0x278: recomputes the flow as parentForward*|v|, then wingObj[+0x15c] = clamp((L_ref + calculateNeutralLift(refFlow, -setPitchOffset, coeff)*setWingToRegulatorRatio + setRegulateToLift) * getGravity() * 0.101833, -1, +1) - a proportional servo command, which is why setRegulateToLift 4.91 really is 'hold this surface at 4.91 m/s^2'. Linux twin: 0x0824ed10.

symbols.name: dice::ref2::world::Wing::calculateNeutralLift
symbols.note: calculateNeutralLift(const Vec3& refFlow, float minusPitchOffset, float coeff). Builds identity Mat4, rotates it by the passed angle (= -WingTemplate.setPitchOffset), composes with the wing's parent transform, extracts row 1, and calls calculateLift with it. So it is the lift the surface WOULD make undeflected at its authored incidence; setWingToRegulatorRatio weights it into the regulator error. This is the only place setPitchOffset is read in the update path - whether it also biases the surface's rest orientation at setup is NOT established. Linux twin: 0x08250690.

symbols.note: Font vtable 0x00919098 +0x24 (function created in Ghidra 2026-09-16). Allocates 0xa8 bytes per character. A space (0x20) emits no quad and advances SpaceWidth x scale; any other character gets a quad whose UVs span width/TextureWidth by Height/TextureHeight, and advances (width + BetweenWidth) x scale, scale being the object's +0x8. symbols.name: Font__loadFontFile
symbols.note: Font vtable 0x00919098 +0x20 (function created in Ghidra 2026-09-16). Reads eight header lines by position with readline + sscanf and no key check - Texture (%s), TextureWidth, TextureHeight, BetweenWidth, SpaceWidth, Height, AlphaTest, AlphaBlend - discards one line, then reads sscanf('%c %f %f %f') rows into a 256-entry, 12-byte glyph table at +0x18 indexed by the raw character byte: U0 = x0/W + 0.5/W, V0 = y0/H + 0.5/H, width = x1 - x0 + 1 (1.0 at 0x008c53c8, 0.5 at 0x008c4220). Header fields: +0xc18 Height, +0xc1c BetweenWidth, +0xc20 SpaceWidth, +0xc24 / +0xc25 AlphaTest / AlphaBlend, +0xc28 / +0xc2c TextureWidth / TextureHeight (ledger FONT-1).

symbols.note: lnxded 0x0832f6e0 read in full. weight >= 1: bone local = quat.toMat, translation = *trans. weight < 1: local rot = slerp(fromMat(current local), quat, weight), translation = cur + (trans-cur)*weight. symbols.name: BoneAnimation::applyOnSkeleton(Skeleton&, float phase, float weight, int mask)
symbols.note: lnxded 0x0832ed60, decompiled in both. 'phase' is a normalized clip position: modf(phase) (negative frac +1) x N -> frameA (N = frames for a looping clip, frames-1 for a one-shot), frameB = (frameA+1) % frames, slerp/lerp by the remainder; one-shots clamp to the first frame below 0 and the last frame above 1. Mask: bit 0x10000 = write frame A's quat/trans straight into the bone local (no blend), remaining bits = max bone level (bone+0xcc), -1 = every bone. Calls setRelativeBoneTransform 0x0066b5c0 with 'weight'. Static oldTime/oldModuleTime cache at DAT_00959c98/DAT_00a5a52c.

symbols.name: rend_vertexFormatToD3DFVF
symbols.note: (uint format, uint out[3]): out[0] = D3DFVF code, out[1] = out[2] = stride. 0x1->D3DFVF_XYZ 0x002, 0x4->XYZRHW 0x004, 0x200000..0x1000000->XYZB1..XYZB4 0x006..0x00c, 0x10->NORMAL 0x010, 0x40->DIFFUSE 0x040, 0x100->SPECULAR 0x080; texcoord set n bits -> D3DFVF_TEXCOORDSIZE1/2/3/4(n) (3/0/1/2 << (16+2n)), then TEX1..TEX4 (0x100..0x400) from the number of sets; 5 sets -> Debug 'Feeeeel!'. Bit 0x20000000 -> FVF|=4, +4 (getStride says +16; never seen in .sm data). Callers: DX8 vertex block ctors 0x006773d0 / 0x00677890, dynamic VB 0x00675520, undefined sites 0x00667d6c, 0x00675c0e. The buffer is an FVF buffer, so component order is Direct3D's: position(+weights), normal, diffuse, specular, tex0..tex3.

symbols.name: SoundScript__skipFilter
symbols.note: First stage of the `.ssc` per-line pipeline and the whole of the engine's comment handling. `/*` and `beginSkip` are one mechanism, not two: `if (line == "endSkip" || line.find("*/") != npos) { g_sscSkipping = 0; return 1; }` then `if (g_sscSkipping) return 1;` then `if (line == "beginSkip" || line.find("/*") != npos) { g_sscSkipping = 1; return 1; }` else return 0. Consequences, all relied on by shipped data: the unit is the LINE, not the character span (`/*load @ROOT/...` in XPack2 `Gewehr43_zf4/Sounds/High.ssc` loses the `load` with it); the close test runs first and unconditionally, so a `*/` with no opener is silently eaten (vanilla `KettenKradEngine.ssc`) and a self-contained `/* ... */` on one line never opens a skip; and an opener needs no terminator — it skips to the end of the parse (vanilla `LynxHorn.ssc`, and 373 of the 849 scripts that use the markers). Returning 1 means the line is consumed, so being first it also swallows `#include` and `#templateLevel` inside a skipped region.

symbols.name: SoundScript__readLine
symbols.note: Reads one `.ssc` line from the current include stream: clears the string, then appends bytes until `\n`, discarding `\r`. No trimming — the line handed to the filters carries its own leading whitespace, so `beginSkip`/`endSkip` match only unindented (their test is `operator==`), while `/*` and `*/` are substring searches and match anywhere on the line.

symbols.name: SoundScript__handleTemplateLevel
symbols.note: `#templateLevel` for `.ssc` — the Options -> Sound detail tier. Second in the per-line pipeline, after the skip filter.

symbols.name: SoundScript__handleInclude
symbols.note: `#include` for `.ssc`. Fourth in the per-line pipeline 0x007fb0e0, so it runs only on lines the skip filter let through.

symbols.name: SoundScript__handleBeginMap
symbols.note: `#beginMap` / `#endMap` for `.ssc`: declares the extern channels the owning object feeds (`Engine::Rpm` and friends). Third in the per-line pipeline.

symbols.name: SoundScript__resetParseState
symbols.note: Clears all `.ssc` parser globals after a top-level parse: the skip flag 0x00a8fb30, the current patch/sample pointers 0x00a8fb28 / 0x00a8fb2c, the `#beginMap` channel 0x0095ac7c / 0x00a8fb34, and the patch list at 0x00a8fcc0. Called once from SoundScript__parse 0x007fb1c0, never per included file — which is what makes the skip flag outlive an include.

symbols.name: SoundScript__handleLine
symbols.note: The `.ssc` per-line pipeline, in order: skipFilter 0x007f9a80, then `#templateLevel` 0x007fa010, then `#beginMap`/`#endMap` 0x007fad10, then `#map` 0x007f9be0, then `#include` 0x007fa3f0, then `newPatch` 0x007f9a00; anything left falls through to the 23-entry command table built by 0x007fde70. The skip filter being first is what makes a comment outrank every directive.

symbols.name: SoundScript__parse
symbols.note: Top-level `.ssc` parse: open, then `while (!atEof()) { readLine 0x007f9ed0; handleLine 0x007fb150 -> 0x007fb0e0; }`, then finalize 0x007f9db0 and resetParseState 0x007fb040. The EOF test walks the include stack (the stream array at 0x00a8fc5c), so every `#include` is read through this same loop and the same globals.

symbols.name: SoundScript__registerCommands
symbols.note: Builds the `.ssc` command table: 23 keywords assigned indices 0..22 in order — load, stream, stereo, loop, volume, pan, minDistance, priority, trigger, randomStartPitch, beginEffect, endEffect, controlSource, controlDestination, envelope, param, paramController, newPatch, randomPlay, relativePosition, dopplerOff, stop, addGroup. `#templateLevel`, `#include`, `#beginMap`, `#map`, `beginSkip` and the comment markers are not in it — they are handled by the pipeline filters ahead of it.

Do not restate the 30 Hz fixed-step claim as settled without reading LOOP-1.
